messages:
Anya: Heads-up — Lynx Health onboarding showing persistent tail latency spikes + token spend ~2.3x vs forecast. Renewal ~45 days. Proactive plan idea: run an int8 quant pilot + route a portion of traffic to a compact model pool in us-east to reduce cost/latency, with automatic fallbacks. Need infra + eng buy-in, and we'll ask the customer for top prompt set for evals.
Mike: Thanks, Anya. Are they on Hosted or Dedicated today? Can you drop the key metrics?
Anya: Hosted. 95th latency jumped from 1.6s -> up to 3.2s during bursts over last 48h. Sustained concurrency ~40 with spikes to 120. Median seq ~120 tokens, tail up to 3k for doc ingestion flows. Cost per 1k tokens higher than forecast.
Raj: We can provision a small dedicated compact pool for a canary in us-east-1. Need quant artifact and perf numbers. What QPS or concurrent sessions should we size for the pool?
Anya: Target canary load ~20% of peak: aim for 25 concurrent sessions to start, auto-scale to 60. Customer is fine with a short test window and redacted prompts.
Olivia: We have an int8 build of rwd-13b-compact-v2 that in our internal evals keeps output quality within noise on our standard evals, but risk of subtle regression exists on domain prompts. Request: provide top 20 customer prompts + a couple hundred real-world examples so we can run automated regression checks. Also propose a fallback to rwd-13b-compact-fp16 for queries flagged as high-accuracy.
Anya: I'll request the prompt set and examples from the account team and ask for permission to run them in our eval harness. Customer agreed to a redacted sample pass.
Raj: Suggested routing config snippet for canary (ops-friendly):
```
route: lynx-onboard-int8-canary
match: client.id == "lynx-health" and traffic.percent <= 20
upstream_priority: [compact-int8-pool-us-east, compact-fp16-pool-us-east, hosted-default]
healthcheck: realtime-token-latency < 2s, error_rate < 0.5%
canary_window: 2h
rollout_steps: [10, 25, 50, 100]
```
Olivia: On rollout, we'll run automated evals at each step. Gate: if BLEU/ROUGE/emd-quality drops > 2% on the customer prompt set or user-facing failure rate increases, rollback automatically. Also add a semantic-similarity check to detect hallucination drift.
Mike: Good. Also capture ROI for the customer: projected token cost savings and latency P50/P95 improvement. Make that slide for renewal conversation. Schedule a joint call for enablement and go/no-go.
Anya: Can we do Wed 10am PT for the call? Will include Solutions Eng and a quick demo of latency/cost dashboard.
Raj: We can schedule infra prep Tue evening and provision the compact pool after the call.
deploy-bot: Canary plan created: canary-lynx-int8-4829999999, scheduled deploy attempt 2026-03-25T10:05:00Z.
Anya: Great — I'll follow up with the customer for the prompt set and open a GH issue with the checklist (eval data, routing config, rollback thresholds, SLO alerts). Tagging @Olivia @Raj for action items. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
